subject.title: fix(ui): prevent Nostr profile publish/import hangs

question: Should Nostr profile publish and import unconditionally fail in the Control UI after 30 seconds, including when the gateway operation may still be progressing?
rationale: The patch intentionally converts an unbounded wait into a new user-visible failure boundary, and repository policy treats that compatibility choice as maintainer-owned.

options.title: Confirm the 30-second deadline
options.body: Keep the fixed deadline after exact-head proof establishes normal and stalled behavior and the Nostr handler contract shows legitimate operations fit within it.

options.title: Choose a longer or server-aligned boundary
options.body: Set the UI deadline above the backend relay-operation limit so the client cannot time out before the gateway’s supported completion window.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Do not add a client deadline until the gateway operation exposes a canonical cancellation or timeout contract.

recommendation.title: Confirm the 30-second deadline
recommendation.body: Keep the fixed deadline after exact-head proof establishes normal and stalled behavior and the Nostr handler contract shows legitimate operations fit within it.

likelyOwner.reason: Integrated the original Nostr profile UI and plugin behavior and is best positioned to confirm its compatibility contract.
